records.introduction: ZuiGO offers 5 service lines: 1) Custom Software Development, 2) AI & Machine Learning, 3) Cloud & DevOps, 4) Healthcare Software, 5) Fintech Software. After a build, ZuiGO can also run launch and growth support (technical SEO, paid acquisition, landing pages, attribution); it follows a build and is not a standalone engagement. Every engagement runs through five phases: Discover, Design, Build, Deploy, Scale.
